revelations.name: Bonded Mount
revelations.summary: Gain a loyal mount that advances as a druid companion.

revelations.name: Erosion Touch
revelations.summary: Damage objects and constructs with a scaling touch.

revelations.name: Friend to the Animals
revelations.summary: Learn nature summoning and bolster nearby animals' saves.

revelations.name: Life Leach
revelations.summary: Drain a living creature to gain temporary hit points.

revelations.name: Natural Divination
revelations.summary: Read natural signs for a save, skill, or initiative bonus.

revelations.name: Nature's Whispers
revelations.summary: Use Charisma instead of Dexterity for Armor Class and CMD.

revelations.name: Speak with Animals
revelations.summary: Speak with an increasing number of animal kinds.

revelations.name: Spirit of Nature
revelations.summary: Stabilize automatically and gain healing when near death.

revelations.name: Transcendental Bond
revelations.summary: Communicate with designated allies and later deliver touch spells.

revelations.name: Undo Artifice
revelations.summary: Permanently reduce crafted objects to natural raw materials.

mysteries.finalRevelation: Create a restorative organic cocoon once per day, emerging eight hours later as a plant, animal, or humanoid type at full health and cleansed of poison, disease, and ability damage.

revelations.name: Acid Skin
revelations.summary: Gain scaling acid resistance and eventual immunity.

revelations.name: Clobbering Strike
revelations.summary: Trip a foe after a critical spell attack.

revelations.name: Crystal Sight
revelations.summary: See through earth, stone, sand, and thinner metal.

revelations.name: Earth Glide
revelations.summary: Move through natural earth and carry passengers.

revelations.name: Mighty Pebble
revelations.summary: Charge a stone into an explosive scaling projectile.

revelations.name: Rock Throwing
revelations.summary: Throw appropriately sized rocks with practiced accuracy.

revelations.name: Shard Explosion
revelations.summary: Burst into damaging shards that create difficult terrain.

revelations.name: Steelbreaker Skin
revelations.summary: Harden your skin so striking weapons take damage.

revelations.name: Stone Stability
revelations.summary: Resist bull rushes and trips and gain the Trip feat chain.

revelations.name: Touch of Acid
revelations.summary: Deal acid damage by touch and later empower held weapons.

mysteries.finalRevelation: Become a master of acid and earth, applying Enlarge, Extend, Silent, or Still Spell to any acid or earth spell without increasing its level or casting time.
